exercises.q: Мэри прикусила ___ (нижняя губа, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Mary bit her bottom lip.
exercises.why: **губа → губу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  **нижний → нижнюю** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with губу). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синяя: A. синюю. Ending -яя → -юю.  Declension: sg. губа · губы · губе · губу · губой · губе; pl. губы · губ · губам · губы · губами · губах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
